headline: Does he love me, or am I imagining it?
note: Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework, after the interior ban was loosened. The read may now ANSWER: the card carries the claim about him. 🔴 THE DENIAL IS STILL BANNED — 'he does not love you' is the one direction she has no use for. 🔴 NO DIAGNOSIS: avoidant, emotionally unavailable, commitment-phobic, narcissist. 🔴 Never grade her (naive, foolish, gave too much). 🔴 No dates. The seven cuts run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why / let me look closer — and every cut must add information the last one did not carry. 🔴🔴 The crueller door stays shut: never that she imagined it, invented it or is seeing what she wants. 🔴 The warrant is the CARD, never the strength of what she felt.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the table is between you and the rest of him.
You asked about his love, and about your own eyes. Your hand went to the card of things truly made.
So you did not imagine it, dear. He loves you.
And this card builds nothing by chance. What stands between you was made on purpose.
But he has put it into the doing, dear, and not into words you can hold.
That's why you keep checking it against your own memory.
Let me look closer at what keeps him from saying it plainly…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — you're seeing him from below, not from level.
You asked about his love, and about your own eyes. Your hand went to the card of a crooked view.
So the love is there, dear. You have been looking at it sideways.
And from down there, every plain thing can look like something else.
But the angle is the trouble, dear. Your eyes are working fine.
That's why one week you are certain, and the next week you are not.
Let me look closer at what has been holding you at that angle…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — the drop is real and it's right there beside his boot.
You asked about his love, and about your own eyes. Your hand went to the card of a man who steps out anyway.
So it's real, dear. You did not build this on your own.
And he stepped out too. That is not a thing a man does over nothing.
But he stepped without once looking at where it lands.
That's why it feels real to you, dear, and unsteady at the same time.
Let me look closer at what makes the ground feel so unsteady…
